issues.instruction: Use the approved glossary term 'AI matting' instead of 'AI matting' (which is correct) but ensure it is capitalized as 'AI Matting' to match source and glossary.
Avoid redundancy: 'Reemplazo de fondo en tiempo real con AI matting' repeats 'AI matting' from the title. Change to 'Reemplazo de fondo en tiempo real'.

Use the approved glossary term 'multi-platform streaming' instead of 'Multi-platform streaming' (which is correct) but ensure it is capitalized as 'Multi-Platform Streaming' to match source and glossary.
Simplify to 'Transmite en vivo con un toque' to avoid redundancy with the title.
Use the approved glossary term 'virtual camera' instead of 'Virtual camera' (which is correct) but ensure it is capitalized as 'Virtual Camera' to match source and glossary.
Change 'Convierte tu teléfono en una cámara virtual' to 'Convierte tu teléfono en una webcam' to match the source 'Turn your phone into a webcam' and use the common term 'webcam'.

Use 'screen casting' as per glossary instead of 'screen casting' (which is correct) but ensure it is written as 'screen casting' (two words) and not 'screen casting' (which is correct). Actually, the candidate has 'screen casting' which is correct, but the glossary says 'screen casting' so it's fine. No change needed.
Change 'AI matting avanzado' to 'AI matting avanzado' (correct) but ensure it is 'AI matting' as per glossary. No change needed.
Change 'multi-platform streaming' to 'streaming multiplataforma' for naturalness, but glossary says 'multi-platform streaming' so it's fine. No change needed.
Change 'Documentación de la API' to 'Documentación de API' to match source 'API Docs' and common usage.
Change 'Colaboraciones' to 'Asociaciones' to match source 'Partnerships' and common Spain usage.
Change 'Hazte revendedor' to 'Conviértete en revendedor' for naturalness.
Change 'Consultas comerciales' to 'Consultas de negocio' to match source 'Business Inquiries'.
